ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p32/r3.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p32/r3.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p32/r3.claim: Disbelievers mock the description of Hell because they presume to know everything, but it rests on divine wisdom: truth-seekers benefit and arrogant know-it-alls ruin their fate.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p32/r3.anchor: Those who have the desire for the truth will benefit from it

ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p46/r1.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p46/r1.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p46/r1.claim: Hell's horror is beyond worldly imagination, and this general warning is not directed at Muhammad.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p46/r1.anchor: Its horror cannot be imagined in this world. Only those will have an idea of it who encounter it.

ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p46/r2.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p46/r2.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p46/r2.claim: The expression means Hell will show no mercy by easing agony and will spare no one; it is wholly ruthless and vigilant.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p46/r2.anchor: to show mercy and clemency.” Though the preposition is not mentioned here and neither is there any occasion for its mention

SAMIN-DURR:74:28/r1.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:74:28/r1.speaker: أبو البقاء
SAMIN-DURR:74:28/r1.claim: Abu al-Baqa takes لا تبقي as a circumstantial accusative governed by the sense of magnification in ما سقر؟.
SAMIN-DURR:74:28/r1.anchor: أنها في محل نصب على الحال، والعامل فيها معنى التعظيم، قاله أبو البقاء

SAMIN-DURR:74:28/r2.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:74:28/r2.speaker: author
SAMIN-DURR:74:28/r2.claim: With an omitted object meaning what is cast into it, the verbs mean it neither spares nor leaves it, but destroys it.
SAMIN-DURR:74:28/r2.anchor: ومفعول " تبقي " و " تذر " محذوف، أي: لا تبقي ما ألقي فيها، ولا تذره

SAMIN-DURR:74:28/r3.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:74:28/r3.speaker: author
SAMIN-DURR:74:28/r3.claim: Alternatively, the omitted object is the person cast into it or any degree of torment, which Saqar inflicts without leaving anything out.
SAMIN-DURR:74:28/r3.anchor: وقيل: تقديره لا تبقي على من ألقي فيها، ولا تذر غاية العذاب إلا وصلته إليه

SAMIN-DURR:74:28/r4.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:74:28/r4.speaker: author
SAMIN-DURR:74:28/r4.claim: A second syntactic analysis makes لا تبقي ولا تذر an independent sentence.

NASHR:v2p104/r1.author: Ibn al-Jazarī
NASHR:v2p104/r1.speaker: author
NASHR:v2p104/r1.claim: A final rāʾ that is sākin after fatḥ or ḍamm is emphatic for all readers; ولا تذر is an example after fatḥ.
NASHR:v2p104/r1.anchor: فلا خلاف في تفخيم الراء في جميع ذلك لجميع القراء

NASHR:v2p104/r2.author: Ibn al-Jazarī
NASHR:v2p104/r2.speaker: author
NASHR:v2p104/r2.claim: A final sākin rāʾ after kasra is light; a following emphatic letter does not change this because it is separated from the rāʾ.
NASHR:v2p104/r2.anchor: ولا خلاف في ترقيق الراء في ذلك كله لوقوعها ساكنة بعد الكسر

ALUSI-FULL:v29p125#3/r1.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v29p125#3/r1.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v29p125#3/r1.claim: The clause describes Saqar and is either explanatory or independent; it need not be treated as the predicate of an omitted subject.
ALUSI-FULL:v29p125#3/r1.anchor: بيان لوصفها وحالها فالجملة مفسرة أو مستأنفة عن غير حاجة إلى جعلها خبر مبتدأ محذوف

ALUSI-FULL:v29p125#3/r2.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v29p125#3/r2.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v29p125#3/r2.claim: An alternative makes the clause circumstantial, governed by the sense of “how great and terrible Saqar is”; al-Ālūsī calls this unconvincing.
ALUSI-FULL:v29p125#3/r2.anchor: وقيل حال من سقر والعامل فيها معنى التعظيم أي أعظم سقر وأهول أمرها

ALUSI-FULL:v29p125#3/r3.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v29p125#3/r3.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v29p125#3/r3.claim: Saqar destroys everything cast into it; after it dies, it does not leave it dead but restores it for renewed punishment.
ALUSI-FULL:v29p125#3/r3.anchor: لا تبقى شيئا يلقى فيها إلا أهلكته وإذا هلك لم نذره هالكا حتى يعاد

ALUSI-FULL:v29p125#3/r4.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v29p125#3/r4.speaker: ابن عباس
ALUSI-FULL:v29p125#3/r4.claim: Ibn ʿAbbās says that once Saqar seizes them it leaves none, and when they are given new bodies it does not leave them free of the first punishment’s return.
ALUSI-FULL:v29p125#3/r4.anchor: وقال ابن عباس لا تبقي إذا أخذت فيهم لم تبق منهم شيئا وإذا بدلوا خلقا جديدا لم تذر أن تعاودهم سبيل العذاب الأول

ALUSI-FULL:v29p125#3/r5.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v29p125#3/r5.speaker: الضحاك
ALUSI-FULL:v29p125#3/r5.claim: Al-Ḍaḥḥāk transmits a similar explanation, adding that everything tires and slackens except Hell.
ALUSI-FULL:v29p125#3/r5.anchor: وروي نحوه عن الضحاك بزيادة ولكل شيء فترة وملالة إلا جهنم

ALUSI-FULL:v29p125#3/r6.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v29p125#3/r6.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v29p125#3/r6.claim: Another explanation says it leaves nothing unharmed and permits nothing to escape destruction; whatever is thrown in will inevitably perish.
ALUSI-FULL:v29p125#3/r6.anchor: وقيل لا تبقي على شيء ولا تدعه من الهلاك بل كان ما يطرح فيها هالك لا محالة

ALUSI-FULL:v29p125#3/r7.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v29p125#3/r7.speaker: السدي
ALUSI-FULL:v29p125#3/r7.claim: Al-Suddī says Saqar leaves them without flesh and does not spare their bones; al-Ālūsī considers this weaker than the preceding explanations.
ALUSI-FULL:v29p125#3/r7.anchor: وقال السدي لا تبقي لهم لحما ولا تذر عظما وهو دون ما تقدم

IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p311/r3.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p311/r3.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p311/r3.claim: “It leaves nothing” elaborates the terror of “what is Saqar?” and serves as another predicate of Saqar.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p311/r3.anchor: من أهوالها أنها تهلك كل من يصلاها

IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p311/r4.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p311/r4.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p311/r4.claim: The object of “leaves nothing” is omitted to make the scope universal: it leaves no one or no part of their bodies.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p311/r4.anchor: أي لا تبقي منهم أحدا أو لا تبقي من أجزائهم شيئا

IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p311/r5.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p311/r5.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p311/r5.claim: “Nor leaves” coordinates with “leaves nothing” and has the force of a circumstantial clause.

IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p311/r6.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p311/r6.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p311/r6.claim: Saqar does not leave anyone cast into it free from its torment; this implies that life is restored after destruction.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p311/r6.anchor: أي لا تتركه غير مصلي بعذابها . وهذه كناية عن إعادة حياته بعد إهلاكه

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p407#6/r1.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p407#6/r1.speaker: author
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p407#6/r1.claim: The fire consumes all their flesh and leaves nothing of it; it also does not spare them when they are created anew.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p407#6/r1.anchor: لا تبقي لهم لحما إلا أكلته ولا تذرهم إذا أعيدوا خلقا جديدا

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p267/r10.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p267/r10.speaker: ابن بريدة وأبو سنان
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p267/r10.claim: Saqar consumes flesh, veins, nerves, and skin, then replaces them; its inhabitants neither die nor live, as Ibn Burayda, Abu Sinan, and others say.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p267/r10.anchor: أي: تأكل لحومهم وعروقهم وعصبهم وجلودهم، ثم تبدل غير ذلك، وهم في ذلك لا يموتون ولا يحيون، قاله ابن بريدة وأبو سنان وغيرهما.

NASAFI-FULL:v4p296#4/r1.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v4p296#4/r1.speaker: author
NASAFI-FULL:v4p296#4/r1.claim: Hell consumes the flesh and spares no bone; alternatively, nothing remains in it without being destroyed, nor can it leave anything intact as it was.
NASAFI-FULL:v4p296#4/r1.anchor: ﴿ لا تبقي ﴾ أي هي لا تبقي لحما ﴿ ولا تذر ﴾ عظما أو تبقي شيئا يبقي فيها إلا أهلكته

RAZI-FULL:v30p178#5/r1.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v30p178#5/r1.speaker: بعضهم
RAZI-FULL:v30p178#5/r1.claim: Some take “spare” and “leave” as synonyms repeated for emphasis, like saying “he turned me away and avoided me.”
RAZI-FULL:v30p178#5/r1.anchor: فمنهم من قال : هما لفظان مترادفان معناهما واحد ، والغرض من التكرير التأكيد

RAZI-FULL:v30p178#5/r2.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v30p178#5/r2.speaker: عطاء عن ابن عباس
RAZI-FULL:v30p178#5/r2.claim: A report from Ibn Abbas through ʿAta says the fire leaves no blood, flesh, or bone; when they are recreated it burns them more intensely again, repeatedly.
RAZI-FULL:v30p178#5/r2.anchor: وهذا رواية عطاء عن ابن عباس

RAZI-FULL:v30p178#5/r3.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v30p178#5/r3.speaker: آخرون
RAZI-FULL:v30p178#5/r3.claim: Another distinction: it leaves no person deserving punishment without torment, then leaves no part of those bodies unburned.
RAZI-FULL:v30p178#5/r3.anchor: ثانيها : لا تبقي من المستحقين للعذاب إلا عذبتهم ، ثم لا تذر

RAZI-FULL:v30p178#5/r4.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v30p178#5/r4.speaker: آخرون
RAZI-FULL:v30p178#5/r4.claim: A further distinction is that the fire leaves no body part, and uses all its power and intensity in tormenting them.
RAZI-FULL:v30p178#5/r4.anchor: وثالثها : لا تبقي من أبدان المعذبين شيئا ، ثم إن تلك النيران لا تذر

TAB-FULL:v23p432#2/r2.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v23p432#2/r2.speaker: author
TAB-FULL:v23p432#2/r2.claim: Saqar's fire leaves no one alive or dead: it burns its inhabitants, renewing its destruction whenever they are recreated.
TAB-FULL:v23p432#2/r2.anchor: هي نار {لا تبقي} [المدثر: 28] من فيها حيا

TAB-FULL:v23p432#2/r3.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v23p432#2/r3.speaker: مجاهد
TAB-FULL:v23p432#2/r3.claim: Mujahid says the fire neither kills them nor lets them live.
TAB-FULL:v23p432#2/r3.anchor: عن مجاهد، قوله: {لا تبقي ولا تذر} [المدثر: 28] قال: لا تميت ولا تحيي

TAB-FULL:v23p432#2/r4.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v23p432#2/r4.speaker: مرثد
TAB-FULL:v23p432#2/r4.claim: Marthad says it consumes them completely and, when they are recreated, takes and devours them again.
TAB-FULL:v23p432#2/r4.anchor: عن مرثد، في قوله: {لا تبقي ولا تذر} [المدثر: 28] قال: لا تبقي منهم شيئا أن تأكلهم

FARRA:v3p205/r1.author: al-Farrāʾ
FARRA:v3p205/r1.speaker: author
FARRA:v3p205/r1.claim: The description warns humankind about Hell; nadhīr can mean warning, as in the cited phrases meaning “my warning” and “my repudiation.”
FARRA:v3p205/r1.anchor:
والنذير قد يكون بمعنى: الإنذار. قال الله تبارك وتعالى: «كيف نذير » و «فكيف كان نكير
» يريد: إنذاري، وإنكاري.

THALABI:v10p73/r1.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v10p73/r1.speaker: author
THALABI:v10p73/r1.claim: Saqar consumes and destroys whatever enters it.

THALABI:v10p73/r2.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v10p73/r2.speaker: مجاهد
THALABI:v10p73/r2.claim: Mujahid says the Fire neither kills nor leaves them alive; it burns them whenever their creation is renewed.
THALABI:v10p73/r2.anchor: قال مجاهد: يعني لا تميت ولا تحيي

THALABI:v10p73/r3.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v10p73/r3.speaker: السدي
THALABI:v10p73/r3.claim: Al-Suddi says it leaves them neither flesh nor bone.
THALABI:v10p73/r3.anchor: وقال السدي: لا تبقي لهم لحما ولا تذر لهم عظما

THALABI:v10p73/r4.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v10p73/r4.speaker: الضحاك
THALABI:v10p73/r4.claim: Al-Dahhak says it seizes them leaving nothing, then annihilates them again when they are restored.
THALABI:v10p73/r4.anchor: وقال الضحاك: إذا أخذت فيهم لم تبق منهم شيئا وإذا أعيدوا لم تذرهم حتى تفنيهم

THALABI:v10p73/r5.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v10p73/r5.speaker: author
THALABI:v10p73/r5.claim: Everything has a pause and weariness except Hell.
THALABI:v10p73/r5.anchor: ولكل شيء فترة وملالة إلا لجهنم

ITQAN:v4p489/r1.author: al-Suyūṭī
ITQAN:v4p489/r1.speaker: author
ITQAN:v4p489/r1.claim: The exegete should avoid alleging needless repetition: paired synonyms can create a combined meaning beyond either word alone, as in “neither leaves nor spares.”
ITQAN:v4p489/r1.anchor: أن يعتقد أن مجموع المترادفين يحصل معنى لا يوجد عند انفراد أحدهما فإن التركيب يحدث معنى زائدا

ITQAN:v4p489/r2.author: al-Suyūṭī
ITQAN:v4p489/r2.speaker: الزركشي
ITQAN:v4p489/r2.claim: Al-Zarkashī says an exegete should respect discourse structure even when it involves metaphor, and avoid assuming words are synonyms because composition adds meaning.
ITQAN:v4p489/r2.anchor: وقال الزركشي في البرهان ليكن محط نظر المفسر مراعاة نظم الكلام الذي سيق له

ITQAN:v4p489/r3.author: al-Suyūṭī
ITQAN:v4p489/r3.speaker: أبو حيان
ITQAN:v4p489/r3.claim: Abū Ḥayyān criticizes tafsirs for reproducing arguments from other disciplines and including unreliable revelation reports, virtue traditions, irrelevant stories, and Israelite histories.
ITQAN:v4p489/r3.anchor: وقال أبو حيان كثيرا ما يشحن المفسرون تفاسيرهم عند ذكر الإعراب بعلل النحو

STUDYQURAN:74:26/r5.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:74:26/r5.speaker: Bg, Ṭ
STUDYQURAN:74:26/r5.claim: “It spares not, nor leaves behind” can mean no one is spared alive and no one is left dead: all are burned, restored, then burned again.
STUDYQURAN:74:26/r5.anchor: Spares not, nor leaves behind indicates that it spares no one by leaving them alive,

STUDYQURAN:74:26/r6.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:74:26/r6.speaker: Q
STUDYQURAN:74:26/r6.claim: Alternatively, Saqar leaves nothing of the bones, skin, or blood; it burns them all.
STUDYQURAN:74:26/r6.anchor: it leaves nothing of the bones, skin, and blood; it burns them all

BURSEVI:v10p178/r11.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v10p178/r11.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v10p178/r11.claim: Saqar burns everything cast into it, then recreates it after death to burn it again; alternatively, it spares nothing through mercy.
BURSEVI:v10p178/r11.anchor: لا تبقى شيئا يلقى فيها إلا أهلكته بالإحراق وإذا هلك لم تذره هالكا حتى يعاد خلقا جديدا

BURSEVI:v10p178/r12.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v10p178/r12.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v10p178/r12.claim: A Persian glossary gives ibqāʾ the meanings preserving and showing compassion, supporting the sense that Saqar leaves no one unharmed.
BURSEVI:v10p178/r12.anchor: قال في تهذيب المصادر الإبقاء باقي كردن ونيز شفقت بردن

TABRISI:74:25-31/r7.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:74:25-31/r7.speaker: مجاهد
TABRISI:74:25-31/r7.claim: Mujāhid says it consumes all their flesh and, when they are recreated, does not leave them alone.
TABRISI:74:25-31/r7.anchor: لا تبقي لهم لحما إلا أكلته ولا تذرهم إذا أعيدوا خلقا جديدا عن مجاهد

TABRISI:74:25-31/r8.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:74:25-31/r8.speaker: الجبائي
TABRISI:74:25-31/r8.claim: Al-Jubbāʾī says it burns everything and spares them none of the full range of torments.
TABRISI:74:25-31/r8.anchor: لا تبقي شيئا إلا أحرقته ولا تذر أي لا تبقي عليهم

WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p432/r8.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p432/r8.speaker: عطاء عن ابن عباس
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p432/r8.claim: ʿAta reports from Ibn Abbas that the Fire burns a person to charcoal, remakes him, and eternally subjects him to punishment more severe than before.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p432/r8.anchor: قال عطاء عن ابن عباس: لا تبقيه حتى تصير فحما، ثم تعاد خلقا جديدا، فلا تذره

WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p432/r9.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p432/r9.speaker: الكلبي
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p432/r9.claim: Al-Kalbi says it consumes all flesh and does not leave them alone when they are recreated.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p432/r9.anchor: وقال الكلبي: لا تبقي له لحما إلا أكلته

WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p432/r10.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p432/r10.speaker: مقاتل
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p432/r10.claim: Muqatil says it consumes them when it reaches them and attacks again after their skins are changed.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p432/r10.anchor: وقال مقاتل: لا تبقي النار عليهم إذا واقعتهم حتى تأكلهم

WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p432/r11.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p432/r11.speaker: الضحاك
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p432/r11.claim: Al-Dahhak says the Fire takes everything, then leaves nothing when they are remade until it destroys them.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p432/r11.anchor: إذا أخذت فيهم لم تبق منهم

WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p432/r12.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p432/r12.speaker: السدي
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p432/r12.claim: Al-Suddi says the Fire leaves neither their flesh nor their bones.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p432/r12.anchor: وقال السدي: لا تبقي لهم لحما ,

ELMALILI:74:26-31/r4.author: Elmalılı Muhammed Hamdi Yazır
ELMALILI:74:26-31/r4.speaker: author
ELMALILI:74:26-31/r4.claim: Saqar consumes every particle of whatever it catches, yet does not release its victim; the victim is recreated and the punishment continues.
ELMALILI:74:26-31/r4.anchor: bir kere çattığı bir şeyi hiçbir zerresi kalmayacak vechile helâk eder, tüketir, sonra da yakasını yine bırakmaz

KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:74:18/r5.author: Hayreddin Karaman, Mustafa Çağrıcı, İbrahim Kâfi Dönmez, Sadrettin Gümüş
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:74:18/r5.speaker: author
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:74:18/r5.claim: Verses 27–28 portray Saqar as a terrifying place that spares nothing, burns what is thrown in, and scorches human skin.
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:74:18/r5.anchor: 27-28. âyetler ise sekar hakkında, “hiçbir şeye acımayan, içine atılanları yakan ve insanın derisini kavuran korkunç bir yer” şeklinde detaylar vermektedir.

NAHHAS:v5p67/r12.author: Abū Jaʿfar al-Naḥḥās
NAHHAS:v5p67/r12.speaker: ابن كيسان
NAHHAS:v5p67/r12.claim: Ibn Kaysān explains deletion in تذر by analogy with يذر, which has no past form and means the same as يدع.
NAHHAS:v5p67/r12.anchor: فالجواب قاله ابن كيسان لما كان يذر بمعنى يدع

ASAD-NOTES:74:25/r3.author: Muhammad Asad
ASAD-NOTES:74:25/r3.speaker: author
ASAD-NOTES:74:25/r3.claim: Hell neither allows life nor leaves the sufferer to die.
ASAD-NOTES:74:25/r3.anchor: It does not allow to live, and neither leaves

ASAD-NOTES:74:25#n13/r2.author: Muhammad Asad
ASAD-NOTES:74:25#n13/r2.speaker: author
ASAD-NOTES:74:25#n13/r2.claim: Asad reads this and Qur'anic descriptions of the hereafter allegorically, as the next verse and verses 28 onward indicate.
ASAD-NOTES:74:25#n13/r2.anchor: The allegorical character of this and all other Qur'anic descriptions of man's condition and destiny in the hereafter is clearly alluded to in the subsequent verse

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p331/r1.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p331/r1.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p331/r1.claim: The fire leaves no person thrown into it untouched and delivers every degree of punishment.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p331/r1.anchor: أي لا تبقي على من ألقي فيها، ولا تذر غاية من العذاب إلا أوصلته إليه

BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p270/r2.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p270/r2.speaker: مجاهد
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p270/r2.claim: Mujahid says it neither kills nor leaves alive: after people burn, they are renewed, neither alive nor dead.
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p270/r2.anchor: وقال مجاهد: لا تميت ولا تحيي يعني لا تبقي من فيها حيا ولا تذر من فيها ميتا كلما احترقوا جددوا.

BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p270/r3.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p270/r3.speaker: السدي
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p270/r3.claim: Al-Suddi says it leaves them neither flesh nor bone.
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p270/r3.anchor: وقال السدي: لا تبقي لهم لحما ولا تذر لهم عظما.

BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p270/r4.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p270/r4.speaker: الضحاك
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p270/r4.claim: Al-Dahhak says when Hell seizes them it leaves nothing, and when they are restored it destroys them again; unlike other things, Hell never tires or weakens.
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p270/r4.anchor: أخذت فيهم لم تبق منهم شيئا وإذا أعيدوا لم تذرهم حتى تفنيهم ولكل شيء ملالة وفترة إلا لجهنم.

BAYDAWI-FULL:74:20-28/r10.author: al-Bayḍāwī
BAYDAWI-FULL:74:20-28/r10.speaker: author
BAYDAWI-FULL:74:20-28/r10.claim: The Fire neither leaves anything thrown into it nor spares it before destroying it; this explains its nature or describes Saqar circumstantially.
BAYDAWI-FULL:74:20-28/r10.anchor: بيان لذلك أو حال من سقر، والعامل فيها معنى التعظيم

BIQAI-FULL:v8p229/r6.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v8p229/r6.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v8p229/r6.claim: Saqar leaves nothing in any condition: it continually destroys what it is allowed to destroy and alters the state of what it is allowed to punish, without fatigue.
BIQAI-FULL:v8p229/r6.anchor: أي تترك على حالة من الحالات ولو كانت أقبح الحالات فضلا عما دونها , بل هي دائمة الإهلاك

DURR-FULL:v8p331/r13.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v8p331/r13.speaker: مجاهد
DURR-FULL:v8p331/r13.claim: Mujahid explains that the Fire neither lets them live nor kills them.
DURR-FULL:v8p331/r13.anchor: عن مجاهد في قوله: {لا تبقي ولا تذر} قال: لا تحيي ولا تميت

DURR-FULL:v8p331/r14.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v8p331/r14.speaker: ابن عباس
DURR-FULL:v8p331/r14.claim: Ibn Abbas says the Fire leaves nothing when it seizes them and does not spare them from renewed punishment when new skin replaces the old.
DURR-FULL:v8p331/r14.anchor: عن ابن عباس {لا تبقي} إذا أخذت فيهم لم تبق منهم شيئا

DURR-FULL:v8p332/r1.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v8p332/r1.speaker: الضحاك
DURR-FULL:v8p332/r1.claim: Al-Dahhak says the Fire consumes them entirely and continues to pursue them when their form returns.
DURR-FULL:v8p332/r1.anchor: عن الضحاك {لا تبقي ولا تذر} تأكله كله فإذا تبدى خلقه لم تذره حتى تقوم عليه

DURR-FULL:v8p332/r2.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v8p332/r2.speaker: ابن بريد
DURR-FULL:v8p332/r2.claim: Ibn Burayd says it consumes flesh, bone, sinew, and marrow, leaving none of them.
DURR-FULL:v8p332/r2.anchor: عن ابن بريد {لا تبقي ولا تذر} قال: تأكل اللحم والعظم والعرق والمخ

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p395#3/r3.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p395#3/r3.speaker: author
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p395#3/r3.claim: The question expresses astonishment at Saqar's enormity; it spares no one cast in and leaves no kind or limit of torment untouched.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p395#3/r3.anchor: هو على معنى التعجب من عظم أمرها وعذابها ثم بين ذلك بقوله لا تبقي ولا تذر

JISHUMI:v10p7161/r6.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v10p7161/r6.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v10p7161/r6.claim: Ibqāʾ is leaving some of what was taken; abqāhu Allāh means that God prolong his life, and al-bāqī is what continues to exist.
JISHUMI:v10p7161/r6.anchor: والإبقاء: ترك شيء مما أخذ، أبقى يبقي إبقاء

JISHUMI:v10p7162/r6.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v10p7162/r6.speaker: أبو مسلم
JISHUMI:v10p7162/r6.claim: Abū Muslim takes the phrase as the ultimate description of burning: Saqar burns everything.
JISHUMI:v10p7162/r6.anchor: هو نهاية الوصف بالإحراق، أي: تحرق كل شيء، عن أبي مسلم

JISHUMI:v10p7162/r7.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v10p7162/r7.speaker: مجاهد
JISHUMI:v10p7162/r7.claim: Mujāhid says Saqar leaves none of its inhabitants alive or dead, but burns them again whenever they are recreated.
JISHUMI:v10p7162/r7.anchor: ولا تذره ميتا، لكن تحرقهم كلما جدد خلقهم، عن مجاهد

JISHUMI:v10p7162/r8.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v10p7162/r8.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v10p7162/r8.claim: Another interpretation says Saqar reaches everyone in Hell and leaves no one without punishment.
JISHUMI:v10p7162/r8.anchor: لا يبقى أحد من أهلها أن تتناوله، ولا تذره من العذاب

JISHUMI:v10p7162/r9.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v10p7162/r9.speaker: أبو علي
JISHUMI:v10p7162/r9.claim: Abū ʿAlī says Saqar burns everything and spares no one, exhausting its victims with every kind of punishment.
JISHUMI:v10p7162/r9.anchor: ولا تذر أي: لا إبقاء عليهم؛ بل تبلغ مجهودهم في أنواع العذاب، عن أبي علي

JISHUMI:v10p7162/r10.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v10p7162/r10.speaker: السدي
JISHUMI:v10p7162/r10.claim: Al-Suddī says Saqar leaves its victims with neither flesh nor bone.
JISHUMI:v10p7162/r10.anchor: لا تبقي لهم لحما، ولا تذر لهم عظما، عن السدي

JISHUMI:v10p7162/r11.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v10p7162/r11.speaker: الضحاك
JISHUMI:v10p7162/r11.claim: Al-Ḍaḥḥāk says Saqar completely consumes people, then consumes them again after their return; unlike everything else, Hell never tires.
JISHUMI:v10p7162/r11.anchor: وإذا أعيدوا لم تذرهم حتى تفنيهم، ولكل شيء فترة وملالة إلا لجهنم، عن الضحاك

KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p652/r2.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p652/r2.speaker: author
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p652/r2.claim: One explanation says Saqar destroys everything cast into it, then restores it rather than leaving it dead.

KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p652/r3.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p652/r3.speaker: author
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p652/r3.claim: Alternatively, it spares nothing and releases nothing from destruction; all thrown there is inevitably destroyed.
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p652/r3.anchor: كل ما يطرح فيها هالك لا محالة

MAWARDI-FULL:v6p142/r13.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p142/r13.speaker: مجاهد
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p142/r13.claim: Mujahid says Hell leaves no one alive and does not leave one dead either.
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p142/r13.anchor: أحدهما : لا تبقي من فيها حيا , ولا تذره ميتا , قاله مجاهد .

MAWARDI-FULL:v6p142/r14.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p142/r14.speaker: ابن عيسى
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p142/r14.claim: Ibn Isa says Hell does not spare anyone from being seized or from punishment.
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p142/r14.anchor: الثاني : لا تبقي أحدا من أهلها أن تتناوله , ولا تذره من العذاب , حكاه ابن عيسى .

MAWARDI-FULL:v6p142/r15.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p142/r15.speaker: author
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p142/r15.claim: A further possibility is that Hell leaves no one healthy and grants no respite.
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p142/r15.anchor: ويحتمل وجها ثالثا : لا تبقيه صحيحا , ولا تذره مستريحا .

MUQATIL:74:18-30/r9.author: Muqātil b. Sulaymān
MUQATIL:74:18-30/r9.speaker: author
MUQATIL:74:18-30/r9.claim: The Fire does not spare them until it consumes them, nor leave them when they swear, but overtakes them.
MUQATIL:74:18-30/r9.anchor: { لا تبقي ولا تذر } [آية: 28] يعني لا تبقى النار إذا رأتهم حتى تأكلهم ولا تذرهم إذا حلفوا لها حتى تواقعهم

QURTUBI-FULL:74:26-29/r6.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:74:26-29/r6.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:74:26-29/r6.claim: Saqar leaves no bone, flesh, or blood unburned; repetition emphasizes totality.
QURTUBI-FULL:74:26-29/r6.anchor: أي لا تترك لهم عظما ولا لحما ولا دما إلا أحرقته

QURTUBI-FULL:74:26-29/r7.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:74:26-29/r7.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:74:26-29/r7.claim: Another view says nothing remains, then they are recreated and burned again continually.
QURTUBI-FULL:74:26-29/r7.anchor: وقيل: لا تبقي منهم شيئا، ثم يعادون خلقا جديدا، فلا تذر

QURTUBI-FULL:74:26-29/r8.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:74:26-29/r8.speaker: مجاهد
QURTUBI-FULL:74:26-29/r8.claim: Mujahid says it leaves no one alive or dead, burning them whenever renewed.
QURTUBI-FULL:74:26-29/r8.anchor: وقال مجاهد: لا تبقي من فيها حيا ولا تذره ميتا

QURTUBI-FULL:74:26-29/r9.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:74:26-29/r9.speaker: السدي
QURTUBI-FULL:74:26-29/r9.claim: Al-Suddi says it leaves no flesh and no bone.
QURTUBI-FULL:74:26-29/r9.anchor: وقال السدي: لا تبقي لهم لحما ولا تذر لهم عظما

ITQAN:v3p190#2/r1.author: al-Suyūṭī
ITQAN:v3p190#2/r1.speaker: author
ITQAN:v3p190#2/r1.claim: Coordinating near-synonyms can serve emphasis; the passage lists paired expressions as examples of this rhetorical type.
ITQAN:v3p190#2/r1.anchor: والقصد منه التأكيد أيضا وجعل منه ﴿ إنما أشكو بثي وحزني ﴾

ITQAN:v3p190#2/r4.author: al-Suyūṭī
ITQAN:v3p190#2/r4.speaker: المبرد
ITQAN:v3p190#2/r4.claim: Al-Mubarrad denies that Qur’an has synonym pairs of this kind and interprets the examples as having distinct senses.
ITQAN:v3p190#2/r4.anchor: وأنكر المبرد وجود هذا النوع في القرآن وأول ما سبق على اختلاف المعنيين

ITQAN:v3p190#2/r5.author: al-Suyūṭī
ITQAN:v3p190#2/r5.speaker: بعضهم
ITQAN:v3p190#2/r5.claim: Another view holds that paired terms together create an added meaning absent from either alone, just as more letters can add meaning.
ITQAN:v3p190#2/r5.anchor: وقال بعضهم المخلص في هذا أن تعتقد أن مجموع المترادفين يحصل معنى
